errors.text_span: Cardio (light blue), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps 'Cardio' to light blue, which actually represents MistralV0.2-Base. 'Cardio' is light orange, 'Gastro' is orange, 'Infect' is darker orange, 'Neuro' is light brown, 'Obstetrics' is medium brown, and 'Pediatrics' is dark brown.

errors.text_span: Each specialty has multiple bars, indicating different fine-tuning conditions or data subsets
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that each specialty has multiple bars indicating different fine-tuning conditions or data subsets. In reality, the bars represent the negative log probability for per-specialty terms, not different conditions or subsets.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the negative log probability for per-specialty terms, which is the primary purpose of the chart.
The description omits the observation that the light blue bars (representing MistralV0.2-Base) are consistently the tallest across all specialty groups.
The description does not mention the linear scale of the y-axis or the tick intervals of one unit from -27 to -22.
The description does not mention that all bars start at -22 and extend downward towards -27.
The description does not mention the legend placement at the top center of the chart.
